Hi Sofia — thanks for flagging this. Good catch — the week of Mar 29 is exactly the EU DST switchover week, which means calendar invites created in CET/CEST could display differently for attendees in EDT/PDT and JST.

Quick thoughts:
- Option A: Move the joint all-hands to the week before (Mar 22–26) where clocks are consistent across EU/US/APAC for everyone.
- Option B: Run two short region-focused sessions (30–45m): one for APAC/EMEA and another for AMER. That avoids painful time slots for any single group.
- Option C: Keep Mar 29 but explicitly include local times in the invite + confirm everyone’s timezone; we can also add a one-line note in the invite about EU DST starting that day.

If you'd prefer Option B, Tessa can create two calendar events and we'll label them Region: APAC/EMEA and Region: AMER. Marcus — are you able to do a slightly earlier AMER-only follow-up (we can record the EMEA session for your team if needed)?

I attached our most recent demo deck (v2) and can tailor a 15m segment for AMER that focuses on latency/cost controls if that's helpful.

—Nikhil
